content.content: 1. Necessity: the document shape leaves something undecided that only a machine-checkable definition can settle — what counts as valid. Fail if validity is already fully determined without the schema. 2. Fidelity: the schema enforces exactly the shape claimed — no stricter, no looser, no additional shape smuggled in. Fail on divergence in either direction; name the diverging rule.
content.rationale: Validity is the last place prose can drift; the gate pins the schema to the shape claim in both directions.
